name: contextual_bench_hotpotqa_eval
description: An evaluation split built around HotpotQA designed to evaluate contextual/multi-hop reasoning under retrieval or context-conditioning. It measures a model's ability to combine information across documents and produce concise, correct answers to multi-step questions.
reputation: A context-focused variant of HotpotQA used in research for multi-hop/contextual evaluation; modest community adoption.
